text:
elaine: quick heads-up. onboarding sample throws different errors across bundlers when consuming the JS SDK that ships both CJS/ESM. trying to capture repros so we can fix in the SDK and add CI checks.

pavel: what errors are you seeing?

elaine: two main failure modes:
1) Vite/esbuild (SSR -> edge) ends up loading the CJS main and runtime errors with "Cannot use import statement outside a module".
2) Webpack (server bundle) sometimes resolves to the ESM file but TS can't find types -> "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'".

rik: classic exports/mains mismatch. can you share package.json from node_modules?

elaine: pasted here:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference",
  "version": "1.6.2",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.esm.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

pavel: exports only exposing package.json -> bundlers fall back differently. modern bundlers honor exports and field names; older ones still look at main/module heuristics. result: inconsistent resolution in the wild.

elaine: repro steps I used (minimal):
- create minimal server SSR sample: index.server.ts imports `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`
- npm i (pulls SDK)
- for vite: `vite build --ssr index.server.ts`, then `node dist/server/index.js` -> error above.
- for webpack: small webpack SSR config -> build succeeds but running typescript-checked CI complains about missing types.

rik: short-term app workarounds:
- Vite: add resolve.alias to point to ESM entry: `resolve: { alias: { '@redwood/inference': '/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.esm.js' } }`
- Webpack: add `resolve.alias` or `module.rules` to treat .js as type: 'javascript/esm' for the package dir. hacky but works for sampleapps.

pavel: proper fix in SDK: add a complete exports map. e.g.:
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./": {
    "import": "./dist/index.esm.js",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```
that makes module resolution deterministic for both import (ESM) and require (CJS), and gives TS explicit types entry.

elaine: note: including `types` under exports is important since some TS setups will only read types if referenced under exports. also add `typesVersions` to help older TS.

rik: CI ideas: add a matrix job that installs the SDK from the built package tarball and runs three quick checks: `vite build --ssr`, `webpack --config webpack.ssr.js`, and `tsc --noEmit` against the sampleapp. failing any indicates a packaging/regression.

ci-bot: created issue #2023 in sdk-packaging: "exports map + bundler smoke tests for ESM/CJS parity".

pavel: another edge quirk: CloudEdge loader doesn't support CJS at runtime for serverless functions. even if your app is built with CJS, the edge runtime expects ESM semantics. so prefer shipping ESM as the primary export for edge-targeted dist.

elaine: thanks. i'll open a PR draft that: updates exports, adds types export, includes a small smoke test in SDK CI, and updates sampleapp README with workaround alias snippets for vite/webpack. will ping for reviews.

pavel: sweet. once merged we should bump a SDK patch and coordinate a sampleapp bump to verify.

rik: if anyone wants the tiny repro (vite + webpack configs + index.server.ts), i put it in a gist at https://gist.redwood/repro-esm-cjs-bundler.

elaine: linking to the onboarding epic so docs/eng-sdks can update: https://go/redwood/epic/onboarding-friction

pavel: thanks all, this will reduce a lot of churn during onboarding. :+1:
